# Behavioral and Project Deep-Dive

[← Perplexity](../README.md) · [Every Perplexity question](../../perplexity.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/behavioral-and-project-deep-dive)

`collaboration` `project-deep-dive` `why-company`

---

## Requirements

Develop concise STAR-based responses for:

- Why Perplexity?
- Which technical stack do you rely on most?
- What recent project has made you most proud?
- Which aspect of a project proved most difficult?
- How did you address obstacles in collaboration across teams?
- Describe a decision you made despite opposition.
- How did you respond when requirements shifted?
- What compensation range or level of pay are you seeking?

## Notes

- Recruiter conversations may evaluate more than basic logistics, so approach them as assessments of fit and communication.
- Interviews related to ML may also test lighter technical fundamentals, including topics such as positional encoding in transformers.
- At staff level, behavioral discussions look for scope, trade-offs, and influence, rather than only details about execution.

## Preparation

- Choose a single project that can withstand both technical probing and behavioral follow-up questions.
- For every story, note the impact, the conflict or uncertainty, the choice you made, and the measurable result.
- Keep your explanation of Why Perplexity brief and connect it to search, answer quality, user-facing AI products, and the particular team.
